name: YTMP3X – YouTube To MP3 Converter Free
description: Convert permitted public YouTube video and Short audio to MP3 locally in Firefox. Choose 128, 192, 256 or 320 kbps.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; frame-src https://youtubetomp3x.com; connect-src 'self' https://www.youtube.com https://*.googlevideo.com; img-src 'self' https://i.ytimg.com; worker-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'
